name: Wangxiang Pozhan
source:
In the year 20XX, as technology continued to advance, Earth’s resources gradually dwindled, and political tensions grew.
It was during this time that a bio-tech-based energy company, Ruinmaker Biotech, developed a groundbreaking innovation: Molecular Reconstruction Technology.
The emergence of this technology completely transformed the world.
Humanity plunged into a prolonged war, all vying for this cutting-edge science that could seemingly turn stone into gold.
In the end, Ruinmaker Biotech deployed Molecular Reconstruction Technology in the war, utterly crushing rival factions and securing ultimate victory.
Using this technology, they built a New City.

Years later, in what remained of humanity’s last sanctuary, an ordinary-seeming student became a "ghost" in the digital world. By chance, he stumbled upon this world’s greatest taboo…

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1108320/_Broken_Delusion/]steam[/url]]
